objective: Measure the best disposable P1 resident available without interrupting KIMI_P0_OPERATIONAL or KIMI-U001.

candidate.recipe: P0 q8 non-routed organs plus q4/group64 routed switch_mlp only

mechanisms: compiled q4 gather_qmm gate/up plus down consumer
packed q8 MLA q_proj plus kv_a projection

short_control.workload: live mlx_vlm HTTP, single stream, max_tokens=512, generated lengths 16-27

long_control.workload: single stream, 486 generated tokens, numbered-list control
long_control.interpretation: co-resident measurements; U001 remained active on P0

measurements.parity_boundary: No whole-model capability qualification. The P0 fused route oracle had exact small q8/q4 sorted/unsorted parity; this P2 result remains an experimental derivative.

rejected_variants.route_sorting: slower and unstable; short controls approximately 36-102 TPS
rejected_variants.shared_requant_q4: not a sustained win; long controls remained below 110 TPS
rejected_variants.mixed_4_8_body: approximately 24-31 TPS on the same fused probe

classification.clean_room_arbitrage: 80 TPS under contention may become roughly 90-110 in a clean resident, but a new resident is not automatically faster and this evidence does not support 150-200.

next_frontier: Only a real Rust/Metal route-major q4/group64 consumer with persistent buffers, selection/attention launch reduction, and held-out capability checks merits reopening the Kimi performance tranche. Otherwise return the GPU to source-bound Flash/Pulsar work.
claim_boundary: Disposable resident evidence only; not Kimi qualification, not Pulsar admission, not a clean-room result, and not permission to restart or replace P0.
